text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder got injured during
training, so I
take her to the infirmary for
treatment.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: 今日は休んでまた頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: That was carelessness on my part.
Let's rest today and give it our best again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This wasn't your fault in any
way.
choice_data_list: 今日は休んでまた頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's rest today and give it our best again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The blame lies with me. I was too caught
up in the
moment and lost track of my
surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: なら、2人とも気をつけよう

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume, and you are my
trainer. We
must compensate for one
another's weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep a sharp lookout for Grass
Wonder's safety
from there on out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Very well. The fault is mine in the first
place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll play it safe for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder returns to her room once
the
treatment is complete.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I do worry that I might
grow restless
not being able to run...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I can endure today so long as I know
it's for a
better tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll restore my energy for now so I won't
miss a
step once treatment is over.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But in return... I ask that you come up
with lots of
new training ideas in the
meantime. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's recovery takes a while,
but once
she gets back on the track, she
shows more
motivation to train than
before.
